requested_scope: Restore only missing/mismatched raw spot-reference files required to validate the immutable Run #994 saved forecasts; accept bytes only if exact frozen SHA-256 values match.

daily_csv.role: NIFTY spot daily reference for saved forecast label/source alignment
daily_csv.source: Yahoo Finance NIFTY index history via existing Phase 3 script; the same script also requests official NSE index archive ZIPs for spot-date cross-checks

intraday_parquet.role: NIFTY spot intraday reference for saved forecast source alignment
intraday_parquet.source: Public HF dataset thetrademarkk/india-index-options-1m, file index/NIFTY.parquet, through existing Phase 3 acquisition script; existing NSE overlap checks are permitted only as part of this spot-reference restoration

recovery_evidence.finding: The artifact contains baseline/report summaries, not the two raw source files.

workflow_incident.incident: A commit adding the offline cache exporter triggered the broad Phase 3 push workflow, which performed daily and HF/NSE overlap acquisition before the workflow's path filter was narrowed. Outputs are excluded from the frozen Run #994 validation unless exact source hashes match.

approval_conditions: Tester must independently review current code blob SHAs and the exact workflow before approving.
No provider request before the authorization script verifies the tester decision and exact SHA pins.
The attempt marker must be uploaded before any source provider request; a prior R1 attempt blocks a repeat.
No option chains, options trades/quotes, contract-master data or unrelated symbols may be requested.
If restored file bytes fail the exact pinned SHA, do not accept or cache them; require a new tester decision for any retry.
The Run #994 artifact, prediction arrays, model fit, holdout and aggregate tolerance remain unchanged.
